info.name: Sanad App — Family
info.description: Family app surface: family bootstrap/profile, elderly dependents (with server-provisioned Elderly login), and family-member invitations. Requires a Normal JWT for a Family account (policy FamilyAccess). Restricted-verification tokens and non-Family accounts receive 403. Run the 0. Auth folder first. Dependents use multipart/form-data for create/photo; everything else is JSON.

item.name: 01. Auth
Register (Family member/invitee)
item.description: The invitee must exist with a Family account before an invitation is created. Register this second user (or verify OTP for both) before folder 3.

item.name: Verify OTP (only if login returns accessType 2)

item.description: Register a Family owner (accountType 1) and a second Family user as invitee, verify OTPs if login returns accessType 2 (restricted), then login. The owner login captures familyToken; the invitee login captures familyInviteeToken.

item.name: Leave family (any member; owner transfers)
item.description: Any member can leave. The caller always leaves; the role is irrelevant. An Owner must pass an existing member's id to transfer ownership first. For Editors/Viewers, transferToMemberId is ignored. 204 on success. 409 OwnerProtected when the owner leaves without a valid transfer target.

item.name: Delete family (Owner, irreversible - run last)
item.description: Owner only. Irreversible: marks the family deleted, anonymizes dependents' names/photo/address and revokes pending invitations; bookings and payments are retained. Requires acknowledgement=true, and refuses while an active booking (409 ActiveBookingExists) or a pending payment (409 UnsettledPaymentExists) exists. The body above is deliberately acknowledgement=false so this request is SAFE to run in smoke (400) — flip it to true only when you really mean it.

item.name: Add dependent (multipart, optional photo)
item.description: Creates the dependent AND provisions an Elderly Identity login (Active, phone verified) for phoneNumber. A second call with the same phone returns 409 PhoneLinkedToAnotherFamily.

item.description: Private storage (elderly-photos). image/jpeg|png|webp, max 5 MB. Replacing deletes the previous file.

item.name: Download dependent photo (member only)
item.description: Returns the image bytes. 404 if no photo. Try with familyInviteeToken after accepting an invitation — Viewers can download.

item.name: Remove dependent (hard delete; identity kept)
item.description: Deletes the families.elderlies row and photo file. The Elderly Identity user remains (can still log in by SMS OTP and can be re-added). Run last in the folder.

item.name: 04. Invitations
Create invitation (Owner/Editor)

// Copy it from the log into the invitationToken variable, then accept/decline.

item.description: role 2 = Editor, 3 = Viewer; relationshipType 6 = Sister. 409 RecipientNotRegistered (unknown email), RecipientMissingFamilyAccount, CannotInviteYourself, AlreadyMember, PendingInvitationExists. The token is returned only by email/log — paste it into invitationToken.

item.name: List my pending invitations (invitee)
item.description: Use the invitee token. Returns the pending invitation(s) addressed to the logged-in user.

item.name: Accept invitation (invitee)
item.description: Adds the invitee to the family as an Editor/Viewer. 204 on success. Requires the invitee's own token (403 NotInvitee otherwise). Run decline instead to test the other branch.

item.name: Revoke invitation (Owner, by id)
item.description: Owner only. Run before accept/decline to test revocation (revoked tokens then return 409 NotPending).
Invitations are by email to existing Family users. Token arrives via deep link sanad://family/invite?token=... (development: the development mail sink prints it to the API log).

request.description: Creates a Paymob intention and returns clientSecret + publicKey for the Paymob mobile SDK (embedded checkout). The webhook — not the SDK callback — is the source of truth. method: 1 Card, 2 Wallet (3 ApplePay reserved).

item.name: Get Privacy Policy / Terms page (anonymous)
item.description: Published legal pages are admin-authored splash screens. Anonymous; 200 with [] when nothing is published.

item.name: List device sessions
item.description: Non-revoked, non-expired sessions only; no token hashes. Maximum five active sessions per account.

item.name: Change password
item.description: 204 revokes EVERY session, including the current one — log in again before running the logout requests below. 401 Identity.Password.InvalidCurrentPassword · 400 Identity.Password.NewPasswordMustDiffer · 404 Identity.Password.UserNotFound.

item.name: Revoke one session
item.description: 204, idempotent. Unknown or foreign session → 404 so ownership is never leaked.

item.name: Log out this device
item.description: 204. Missing or invalid header → 400 Api.Auth.InvalidDeviceSessionHeader.

item.name: Log out all devices
item.description: 204; revokes every non-revoked session of the account.
